installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Python App Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Paket pip TIDAK diinstall di sini; diinstall saat start (sesuai versi Python image yang dipilih).
apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ libtool

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo -e "assuming user knows what they are doing have a good day."
    exit 0
fi

if [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    echo -e "Git Repo Address kosong, tidak ada yang di-clone."
    exit 0
fi

## add git ending if it's not on the address
if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
fi

if [ -z "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    echo -e "using anon api call"
else
    GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
fi

## pull git python repo
if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
    echo -e "/mnt/server directory is not empty."
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        echo -e ".git directory exists"
        if [ -f .git/config ]; then
            echo -e "loading info from git config"
            ORIGIN=$(git config --get remote.origin.url)
        else
            echo -e "files found with no git config"
            echo -e "closing out without touching things to not break anything"
            exit 10
        fi
    fi

    if [ "${ORIGIN}" == "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
        echo "pulling latest from github"
        git pull
    fi
else
    echo -e "/mnt/server is empty.\ncloning files into repo"
    if [ -z "${BRANCH}" ]; then
        echo -e "cloning default branch"
        git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    else
        echo -e "cloning ${BRANCH}'"
        git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    fi
fi

echo -e "install complete"
exit 0

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description:
Git repo to clone

I.E. https://github.com/BimxyzDev/repo_name

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description:
What branch to pull from github.

Default is blank to pull the repo default branch

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description:
Password to use with git.

It's best practice to use a Personal Access Token.
https://github.com/settings/tokens

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description:
Skip all the install stuff if you are letting a user upload files.

0 = false (default)
1 = true

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description:
Pull the latest files on startup when using a GitHub repo.

0 = false (default)
1 = true

variables.name: Command Run
variables.description: Command untuk menjalankan app, contoh: python app.py. Kosongkan jika hanya ingin Shell Console (butuh Enable Shell Console = 1).

variables.name: Requirements file
variables.description: Requirements file yang di-install saat start (pip install -U -r).

variables.name: Additional Python packages
variables.description: Install paket pip tambahan saat start. Pisahkan dengan spasi.

variables.name: Remove Python packages
variables.description: Uninstall paket pip saat start. Pisahkan dengan spasi.

variables.name: Enable Cloudflare Tunnel
variables.description: Set 1 untuk mengaktifkan Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared bawaan image bimxyzdev). Set 0 untuk menonaktifkan. Default: 0.

variables.name: Cloudflare Tunnel Token
variables.description: Opsional. Kosongkan untuk Quick Tunnel dengan URL *.trycloudflare.com (muncul di console & cloudflared.log). Isi token Named Tunnel untuk domain custom.

variables.name: Enable Shell Console
variables.description: Set 1 untuk mengaktifkan Shell Console: command di console dieksekusi sebagai bash dan server tidak berhenti saat app selesai/crash, hanya berhenti saat di-stop atau ketik exit. Default: 0.
